newsitem.title: USA: Thermogenesis gets FDA OK on blood device.
newsitem.headline: Thermogenesis gets FDA OK on blood device.

text.p: Thermogenesis Corp said Tuesday it had received Food and Drug Administration approval to market the Hemo-Matic Blood Collection Monitor in the U.S.
The company is the exclusive U.S. and Canadian distributor for the device, an automated blood weigher/mixer used by phlebotomists to collect blood donations.
The device is made by HemoPharm Service S.A. in France.
Thermogenesis said it will place eight devices in an April field test trial.

It will then begin marketing the monitor to the American Red Cross blood centers and other independent blood collection centers, community blood banks and hospitals across the U.S., which represents a potential market of about 9,000 units, it said.
The company estimates an additional market of 1,000 units in Canada.
